title: fix(ui)!: dashboards, reports and dataset charts send their package on dataset queries (ADR-0150 D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBGAwomnzAVkX6vf246wTwdV)_

Fixes #32077

Clause-②: yes (narrowing + widening) — a dashboard, report or list-view chart whose dataset only a dependency of its own package holds is refused where it was served (BREAKING, FROM → TO under Acceptance notes); and `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s `queryDataset` accepts an optional `packageId` option, `@object-ui/core` exports `servedPackageId`, and `DatasetWidget` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`) and `ObjectChart` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`) accept an optional `packageId` prop. Nothing an item with no package sends changes.
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of the readers epic #31527 (ADR-0150 D5). The server half landed as #32072 (PR #32098, `fb71296c`). This card lands before #31700.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：仪表盘、报表和列表视图的数据集图表查询 `POST /analytics/dataset/query` 时，带上引用它的那个元数据项自己的包（served `_packageId`），作为精确限定 `?package=`；环境里创建的项和内联 dataset 不带。
- 为什么改：#32072 之后，两个包都带同名 dataset 时裸名查询答 409；#31700 放开后这会让仪表盘坏掉。带上自己的包，就各查各的。
- 风险与回滚：没有包的项请求字节不变（不带参数）；带包的项多一个查询参数。收窄一处（暂行，裁决 A）：包 P 的仪表盘若引用只在 P 依赖包里的 dataset，会从“能查到”变成 409，暂时的修法是把 dataset 放进自己的包，#32310/#32311 会恢复。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 的 `queryDataset`、`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` 的 `ReportPackageContext`、`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.test.tsx -t 'objectstack#32077'`，预期 4 条全绿（两个包各查各的、无包不带参数、无包且两持有者时显示冲突原句）。
- 需要你做的：无，史诗席位红线评审 PASS 后由席位落地。

## What changes

**Where each caller's package comes from (measured).** Every item the console renders from `/meta` carries the read decoration `_packageId`, stamped by the server's list and item reads (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`, `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`). Two served values name no package: `sys_metadata` (the overlay provenance sentinel) and `__runtime__`. The new `servedPackageId(item)` in `@object-ui/core` reads an item's own decoration and returns `undefined` for those two, for an empty value, and for an item with none.

| Caller | Package sent | Where it is read |
|---|---|---|
| `DatasetWidget` | the dashboard's | new `packageId` prop, set by `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` from `servedPackageId(schema)` (the dashboard document as served; `DashboardView` passes it whole) |
| `DatasetReportRenderer` | the report's | `servedPackageId(report)`, provided once through a module-private context to every selection (table, matrix, chart, each joined block) |
| `ObjectChart` (dataset arm) | the host's | new host-owned `packageId` prop (not a schema key); the console's list-view chart passes the VIEW's own `servedPackageId(viewDef)`, never the object's or the app's |
| `DashboardFilterBar` | none | its option query posts an INLINE synthetic dataset over `from.object` (`body.dataset`, not `datasetName`); the server reads `?package=` only on the by-name branch, and objects keep their literal name |
| `DatasetPreview` (fifth candidate) | none | it posts the draft INLINE (`queryDataset(draft, …)`), so it is not a by-name caller |

**The shared client.** `queryDataset(dataset, selection, { packageId })` appends `?package=ID` only when `dataset` is a saved NAME and `packageId` is a non-empty string. An inline dataset never carries it.

**The `409` display.** The adapter already lets an unclassified coded refusal through its generic branch with the server's sentence (`Dataset query failed: 409 Conflict — …`), and `DatasetWidget` and the report draw that message in their existing error state. The server's `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` sentence names every candidate, so the conflict is shown with no new string and no new branch. Nothing retries: one query per selection, pinned. No i18n string moved, so the eager `en` pack is untouched.

**Never guessed.** The package is never derived from a result, from the app that hosts the item, or from the object a view belongs to.

## Tests

The card's pins, each a new `describe` in the component's existing harness file:

- `queryDataset.test.ts`: two callers with two packages send `?package=com.acme.alpha` and `?package=com.acme.beta`, with the name kept in the body. No package means no query string. An inline draft with a package sends none. A `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` throws with both candidates in the message, after one request.
- `DatasetWidget.test.tsx`: two `DashboardRenderer`s, served from `com.acme.alpha` and `com.acme.beta`, query the same `sales` name and each draws its own package's number (111 vs 222). An environment dashboard sends no third argument, whether `_packageId` is absent or `sys_metadata`. A widget with no package, where two packages hold the name, shows the conflict naming both after one query. A dashboard in P whose dataset only P's dependency holds sends `?package=P`, shows the `409` naming the holder, and is not retried bare.
- `DatasetReportRenderer.test.tsx`: the same two-package pin for reports, every joined block naming the report's package, and the no-package conflict.
- `ObjectChart.datasetMeasureLabel.test.tsx`: two hosts send two packages; a host with none sends none.
- `served-package.test.ts`: the decoration read and its six package-less cases.

## Acceptance notes

- **BREAKING (interim, the epic's ruling A).** **FROM:** a dashboard, report or list-view chart in package P, whose dataset only a dependency of P holds, is served by the bare read. **TO:** it is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`not-held-by-qualifier`), naming the holder, and the item shows that sentence. **The interim fix:** ship the dataset in the item's own package. Follow-ups #32310 (a caller-package arm on the dataset query door, with closure semantics) and #32311 (the console switches to it) restore the dependency case. The changeset carries this as `**BREAKING**`, still at `patch`, with ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- **The exact qualifier is not the closure read.** ADR-0150 D3 resolves a reference written inside package P "from P", which reaches the one holder in P's dependency closure. `?package=P` at this door is the exact qualifier (`/meta`'s meaning, D5): P's own dataset, or a `409` naming the holders. So a dashboard in P whose dataset only a DEPENDENCY of P holds is refused under this change, where the bare read served it. The card prescribes the dashboard's own package, and the ADR's G1/U rows declare the same consequence for the Studio reads. First-party it is 0: every first-party dataset sits in the package of the dashboard or report that reads it (showcase, CRM, todo, and platform-objects' `system.datasets.ts`, which sits beside the System Overview dashboard). For the epic seat's red-line read.
- **Two sibling by-name dataset READS still go bare.** These are not the query door: `useReportDateDimension` (`GET /api/v1/meta/dataset/NAME` in `ReportDateRange.tsx`) and `ObjectChart`'s option-colour probe (`GET /api/v1/meta/dataset/NAME`). Both are best-effort, and a `409` there degrades to the state of a failed read. They were outside this card's file surface and are reported to the seat.
- **A list-view chart whose view is inline in an object document carries no `_packageId` of its own**, so it queries bare, as before. Only a view served as its own item names a package.

## Verification

Round 2 (head `62e485eb`) adds the narrowing declaration and its pin. Readings for it: `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` `Tests 75 passed (75)`. The new pin's ablation (DatasetWidget drops the package argument) fails it, 1 failed, and the restore leaves `git diff HEAD` empty. `check-adr-0087-registration` reads `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset` exit 0. The full dogfood battery, which a `(narrowing)` arm owes, is reported to the seat. Everything else below was read on round 1's head `bef0c0cf`.

<details><summary>Pins and affected suites</summary>

- The five touched test files: `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 183 passed (183)`.
- The suites of every package the diff moves, plus the console list-view chart file and the metadata-admin previews: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/ packages/core/ packages/plugin-charts/ packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/plugin-report/ packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.chartConfigForward-7891.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/`: `Test Files 858 passed (858)`, `Tests 11193 passed | 49 skipped (11242)`.
- Type-check (`tsc --noEmit` plus each `tsconfig.test.json`) of `@object-ui/core`, `data-objectstack`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-report` and `app-shell`: all `Done`, verdict exit 0.
- eslint on the 13 touched files: 0 errors (warnings only, already present).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; every leg restored, blob equal to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

`@object-ui/*` resolves to source under ui/'s vitest, so no dist rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.

1. The adapter drops `?package=` (the URL suffix replaced by an empty string): `two packages holding one name: each caller sends its own package as the exact qualifier` fails.
2. `DatasetWidget` drops the package argument: `two packages hold one dataset name: each dashboard queries its own, under its own package` fails, 1 failed and 3 passed. The three that pass are the no-package and conflict cases, which do not depend on the parameter.
3. `DatasetReportRenderer` drops it: the two-package report pin and the joined-block pin fail, 2 failed and 1 passed.
4. `ObjectChart` drops it: `two hosts in two packages: each query names its own package` fails, 1 failed and 1 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 38 families, plus check:eager-closure)</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- 37 of 38 exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exited 1 on two 15 s timeouts while sibling locked runs were loading the box (`check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.test.ts`, `js-comment-mask-returns-interpolation-9424.test.ts`). Neither file reads anything this diff touches. Re-run alone: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 30 passed (30)`.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure`, after a `@object-ui/console...` closure build: every ceiling green. `i18n-locale-en` reads 60.4 KB of 60.5 KB, unchanged, because no string moved.

</details>

<details><summary>Live check</summary>

NOT MEASURED, because a dev boot that composes two packages shipping one dataset name needs a purpose-built two-package stack, and nothing first-party ships one. The server's half of that scenario is pinned by `test/dataset-package-scoped-readers.dogfood.test.ts` (PR #32098). This PR pins the client's half at the adapter, widget, report and chart layers above.

</details>
